source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director, on Shoshannim. Eduth. Of Asaph. A psalm.

en.L: For the director: on shoshannim; eduth. Of Asaph. A psalm.
en.B: For the music director. On shoshannim eduth. Of Asaph. A psalm.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To the tune "Lilies of the Covenant". By Asaph. A song.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : sur shoshannim ; édouth. D’Asaph. Psaume.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Sur shoshannim édouth. D’Asaph. Psaume.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Sur l’air « Les lis de l’alliance ». D’Asaph. Chant.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa shoshanimu; eduthi. Ya Asafu. Zaburi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa shoshanimu eduthi. Ya Asafu. Zaburi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa sauti ya "Maua ya Yungiyungi ya Agano". Ya Asafu. Wimbo.

es.L: Al director del coro: sobre shoshannim; edut. De Asaf. Salmo.
es.B: Al director del coro. Sobre shoshannim edut. De Asaf. Salmo.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Con la melodía «Lirios del pacto». De Asaf. Canto.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: on shoshannim, eduth: "on lilies, a testimony"
alternatives: to the tune of a song called Lilies of the Covenant
decisions.reason: Shoshannim means lilies (45:1; 69:1), and eduth means a testimony or covenant law (60:1 has the same pair). Together they probably name a tune or a way of performing the psalm. Their exact sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work. Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name. "Of Asaph" may mean the psalm belongs to his family's collection.

decisions.choice: to the tune "Lilies of the Covenant"
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense of the terms (m3).

decisions.choice: "shoshannim" and "édouth" kept as names (Literal, Balanced); "Sur l'air « Les lis de l'alliance »" (Readable)
alternatives: "sur les lis, témoignage" at every level
decisions.reason: The words mean "lilies" and "testimony" and probably name a tune (meaning decision m3). As in the English, Literal and Balanced keep them; Readable gives the probable sense. "Édouth" is written with French spelling.

decisions.choice: "shoshanimu" and "eduthi" kept as names at Literal and Balanced; Readable names the tune "Maua ya Yungiyungi ya Agano" (Lilies of the Covenant), as the English Readable does
alternatives: translating both words at every level
decisions.reason: The words mean "lilies" and "a testimony"; how they were used in the music is no longer known, so Literal and Balanced keep them as the English does.

decisions.choice: shoshannim; edut (L, B); Con la melodía «Lirios del pacto» (R)
decisions.reason: Shoshannim means "lilies" and eduth "testimony" or "covenant"; together they are probably the name of a tune. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew words, as the English does; Readable gives the meaning as a tune name, which is a guess.

source.text: רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל׀הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Shepherd of Israel, give ear, leading like a flock Joseph, sitting [on] the cherubim, shine forth!

en.L: Shepherd of Israel, give ear, \q [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who] lead Joseph like a flock! \q [You who] sit [on] the cherubim, shine forth!
en.B: Turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to us, Shepherd of Israel, \q guiding Joseph like a flock! \q Throned above the cherubim, blaze out in splendor!
en.R: Shepherd of Israel, listen to us! \q You lead Joseph's people like a flock of sheep. \q You sit on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne above the cherubim. Show {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} shining glory!

fr.L: Berger d’Israël, prête l’oreille, \q [{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui] conduis Joseph comme un troupeau ! \q [Toi qui] sièges [sur] les chérubins, resplendis !
fr.B: Prête-nous l’oreille, Berger d’Israël, \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui guides Joseph comme un troupeau ! \q Toi qui sièges au-dessus des chérubins, éclate dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} splendeur !
fr.R: Berger d’Israël, écoute-nous ! \q Tu conduis le peuple de Joseph comme un troupeau de moutons. \q Tu es assis sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône au-dessus des chérubins. Montre-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire éclatante !

sw.L: Ee Mchungaji wa Israeli, tega sikio, \q [{{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}] umwongozaye Yusufu kama kundi! \q [Wewe] uketiye [juu ya] makerubi, uangaze!
sw.B: Utege sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwetu, Ee Mchungaji wa Israeli, \q unayemwongoza Yusufu kama kundi! \q Wewe uliyeketi juu ya makerubi, ung'ae kwa fahari!
sw.R: Mchungaji wa Israeli, utusikilize! \q Wewe unawaongoza watu wa Yusufu kama kundi la kondoo. \q Umeketi katika kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi juu ya makerubi. Ujionyeshe katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unaong'aa!

es.L: Pastor de Israel, escucha, \q [{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que] guías a José como a un rebaño. \q [Tú que] estás sentado [sobre] los querubines, ¡resplandece!
es.B: Inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído hacia nosotros, Pastor de Israel, \q que guías a José como a un rebaño. \q Tú que reinas sobre los querubines, ¡muestra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} esplendor!
es.R: ¡Pastor de Israel, escúchanos! \q Tú guías al pueblo de José como a un rebaño de ovejas. \q Tú estás sentado en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono sobre los querubines. ¡Muéstrate en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gloria resplandeciente!

decisions.choice: Shepherd of Israel: God as shepherd
decisions.reason: The psalm picks up the picture at the end of Psalm 79: the people are God's flock and he leads them (Genesis 48:15; 77:21).

decisions.choice: Joseph: the northern tribes
decisions.reason: Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh were the largest of the northern tribes (verse 3). "Joseph" stands for the people of the north, or for all Israel (77:16).

decisions.choice: sitting on the cherubim: enthroned above the ark
decisions.reason: Two golden cherubim, winged heavenly creatures, stood over the lid of the ark, and God was pictured as seated above them as king (Exodus 25:22; 1 Samuel 4:4; 99:1).

decisions.choice: shine forth: appear in shining glory
decisions.reason: The verb (yafa', causative) is used of God appearing in light to save or to judge (50:2; 94:1; Deuteronomy 33:2).

decisions.choice: turn your ear to us (B); listen to us (R)
decisions.reason: The request is for God to listen; Balanced and Readable say whom to.

decisions.choice: Joseph's people
decisions.reason: Readable says that Joseph stands for a people (m2).

source.text: לִפְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם׀וּבִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת־גְּבֽוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your might, and come for salvation for us.

en.L: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh \q stir up {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might, \q and come for salvation for us!
en.B: Before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh, \q rouse {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength \q and come to rescue us!
en.R: Wake up {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power where Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh can see it. \q Come and save us!

fr.L: Devant Éphraïm, Benjamin et Manassé, \q réveille {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance, \q et viens pour notre salut !
fr.B: Devant Éphraïm, Benjamin et Manassé, \q réveille {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force \q et viens nous délivrer !
fr.R: Réveille {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance sous les yeux d’Éphraïm, de Benjamin et de Manassé. \q Viens nous sauver !

sw.L: Mbele ya Efraimu na Benyamini na Manase \q uamshe uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q uje kwa wokovu wetu!
sw.B: Mbele ya Efraimu, Benyamini na Manase, \q uziamshe nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} \q uje kutuokoa!
sw.R: Uamshe uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mahali ambapo Efraimu, Benyamini na Manase wanaweza kuuona. \q Njoo utuokoe!

es.L: Delante de Efraín y de Benjamín y de Manasés \q despierta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder, \q ¡y ven a salvarnos!
es.B: Delante de Efraín, Benjamín y Manasés, \q despierta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fuerza \q ¡y ven a rescatarnos!
es.R: Despierta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder donde Efraín, Benjamín y Manasés puedan verlo. \q ¡Ven y sálvanos!

decisions.choice: Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh: the tribes of Rachel's sons
decisions.reason: Ephraim and Manasseh were Joseph's sons, and Benjamin was Joseph's brother; all descend from Rachel. In the wilderness these three tribes camped together on the west side of the tabernacle and marched behind it (Numbers 2:18-24).

decisions.choice: before Ephraim goes with "stir up"
alternatives: shine forth before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh
decisions.reason: The verse division and the Hebrew accents join "before Ephraim ..." to "stir up your might". It can also be read with "shine forth" at the end of verse 2. Either way God is asked to act where these tribes can see it.

decisions.choice: stir up: rouse to action
decisions.reason: The verb ('ur) is used for waking someone from sleep (44:24). God's power seems asleep, and the people ask him to rouse it.

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃

records.literal_gloss: God, restore us, and make shine your face, and we will be saved.

en.L: God, restore us, \q and make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face shine, that we may be saved.
en.B: God, bring us back! \q Turn the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face on us, and we will be saved.
en.R: God, make us what we were before. \q Look on us with kindness, and we will be saved.

fr.L: Ô Dieu, ramène-nous, \q et fais briller {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et nous serons sauvés.
fr.B: Ô Dieu, fais-nous revenir ! \q Tourne vers nous la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et nous serons sauvés.
fr.R: Dieu, rends-nous ce que nous étions avant. \q Regarde-nous avec bonté, et nous serons sauvés.

sw.L: Ee Mungu, uturudishe, \q na uangaze uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili tupate kuokolewa.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, uturudishe! \q Utuangazie nuru ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nasi tutaokolewa.
sw.R: Mungu, utufanye tuwe kama tulivyokuwa zamani. \q Utuangalie kwa wema, nasi tutaokolewa.

es.L: Oh Dios, haznos volver, \q y haz brillar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, para que seamos salvados.
es.B: ¡Oh Dios, tráenos de vuelta! \q Haz que la luz de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro nos alumbre, y seremos salvados.
es.R: Dios, haz que volvamos a ser lo que éramos. \q Míranos con bondad, y seremos salvados.

decisions.choice: restore us: bring us back
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv, causative) means to bring back or restore. It may ask God to bring the people back to their former state, to return them from exile, or to turn them back to himself. The prayer is for a full return.

decisions.choice: make your face shine: show us favor
decisions.reason: The words echo the priests' blessing, "the LORD make his face shine on you" (Numbers 6:25; compare 4:7; 31:17; 67:2). A shining face is a look of kindness.

decisions.choice: the refrain
decisions.reason: The line returns at verses 8 and 20, each time with a fuller name for God: God, God of hosts, the LORD God of hosts.

decisions.choice: that we may be saved: the result of God's favor
decisions.reason: The last verb follows from the first two: when God restores his people and looks on them with favor, they are saved.

decisions.choice: look on us with kindness; make us what we were before
alternatives: make your face shine; restore us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the shining face and the restoring mean (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: the refrain (verses 4, 8, 20) is worded the same each time at each level, with only the name of God growing: "uturudishe ... uangaze uso wako"
alternatives: varying the wording of the refrain
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line word for word apart from the names for God, and the English keeps it the same; Swahili does too, so the reader hears the refrain return.

decisions.choice: haznos volver; haz brillar tu rostro (L); tráenos de vuelta (B); haz que volvamos a ser lo que éramos; míranos con bondad (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain asks God to bring his people back and to look on them with favour, the shining face of the priestly blessing (Numbers 6:25). Spanish keeps the same words each time the refrain comes back (verses 4, 8 and 20), as the English does.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד־מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH God hosts, until when have you smoked against [the] prayer of your people?

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God of hosts, \q until when have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} smoked against the prayer of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people?
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God of Armies, \q how long will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} seethe with anger even while {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people pray?
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God of Armies, \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people keep praying to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stay angry. \q How long will this go on?

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu des armées, \q jusqu’à quand fumeras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} contre la prière de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple ?
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu des armées, \q combien de temps vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bouillir de colère pendant que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple prie ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu des armées, \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple ne cesse de {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prier, mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} restes en colère. \q Combien de temps cela va-t-il durer ?

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa majeshi, \q mpaka lini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umefuka moshi juu ya maombi ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}?
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa majeshi, \q mpaka lini utawaka hasira hata watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanapoomba?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa majeshi, \q watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanaendelea kukuomba, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unabaki na hasira. \q Hali hii itaendelea mpaka lini?

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de los ejércitos, \q ¿hasta cuándo has humeado contra la oración de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo?
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de los Ejércitos, \q ¿hasta cuándo estarás airado mientras {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo ora?
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de los Ejércitos, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo sigue orando a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sigues enojado. \q ¿Hasta cuándo va a seguir esto?

decisions.choice: LORD God of hosts: an unusual chain of names
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts three names side by side, YHWH, 'Elohim and tseba'ot. The same form is found in 59:6 and 84:9. Here the divine name appears in a psalm that otherwise says "God", as Psalms 42-83 usually do.

decisions.choice: smoke against: fume in anger
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as smoke from a fire (74:1; 18:9). The verb is in the past form: God has been angry for a long time and still is.

decisions.choice: against the prayer: even while they pray
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "against" or "during". God's anger has not turned aside even though his people pray to him.

decisions.choice: LORD God of Armies
decisions.reason: As with "the LORD of hosts", the title names God as commander of the armies of heaven and of his people. Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies".

source.text: הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝תַּשְׁקֵ֗מוֹ בִּדְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: You have fed them bread of tear[s], and made them drink with tears [by the] third.

en.L: You have fed them [the] bread of tears, \q and made them drink tears by the third.
en.B: You have made tears their food, \q and given them full measures of tears to drink.
en.R: You have made them cry so much \q that tears are their food and their drink.

fr.L: Tu les as nourris [du] pain des larmes, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as abreuvés de larmes au tiers.
fr.B: Tu as fait des larmes leur nourriture, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as donné à boire des larmes à pleine mesure.
fr.R: Tu les as fait tant pleurer \q que les larmes sont leur nourriture et leur boisson.

sw.L: Umewalisha mkate wa machozi, \q na kuwanywesha machozi kwa kipimo cha theluthi.
sw.B: Umeyafanya machozi kuwa chakula chao, \q na kuwapa vipimo vizima vya machozi wanywe.
sw.R: Umewafanya walie sana \q hata machozi yamekuwa chakula chao na kinywaji chao.

es.L: Les has dado a comer pan de lágrimas, \q y les has dado a beber lágrimas en gran medida.
es.B: Les has dado lágrimas por alimento, \q y les has dado a beber lágrimas en abundancia.
es.R: Los has hecho llorar tanto \q que las lágrimas son su comida y su bebida.

decisions.choice: the bread of tears: weeping as daily food
decisions.reason: Grief has become as constant as eating and drinking (42:4; 102:10).

decisions.choice: by the third: in large measure
decisions.reason: The word (shalish) means "a third", here probably a measure, a third of some larger unit (Isaiah 40:12). The point is a large amount.

decisions.choice: full measures (B); so much (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the measure rather than its name (m2).

source.text: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: You make us a strife to our neighbors, and our enemies mock to themselves.

en.L: You make us a strife to our neighbors, \q and our enemies mock among themselves.
en.B: You make us something our neighbors fight over, \q and our enemies sneer at us among themselves.
en.R: You let our neighbors fight over us. \q Our enemies make fun of us.

fr.L: Tu fais de nous une querelle pour nos voisins, \q et nos ennemis se moquent entre eux.
fr.B: Tu fais de nous un sujet de dispute pour nos voisins, \q et nos ennemis ricanent de nous entre eux.
fr.R: Tu laisses nos voisins se disputer à notre sujet. \q Nos ennemis se moquent de nous.

sw.L: Unatufanya kuwa ugomvi kwa jirani zetu, \q na adui zetu hudhihaki kati yao wenyewe.
sw.B: Unatufanya kitu ambacho jirani zetu wanakigombania, \q na adui zetu hutudharau kati yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Unawaacha jirani zetu wagombane juu yetu. \q Adui zetu wanatudhihaki.

es.L: Nos haces motivo de contienda para nuestros vecinos, \q y nuestros enemigos se burlan entre sí.
es.B: Nos has convertido en algo por lo que pelean nuestros vecinos, \q y nuestros enemigos se mofan de nosotros entre ellos.
es.R: Dejas que nuestros vecinos peleen por nosotros. \q Nuestros enemigos se burlan de nosotros.

decisions.choice: a strife: something the neighbors quarrel over
decisions.reason: The word (madon) means strife or a quarrel. The neighbors fight over the spoils of Israel, or Israel is the cause of their quarrels. Some ancient translations read "a byword".

decisions.choice: to themselves: among themselves
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "they mock for themselves", that is, privately, among themselves. The ancient Greek and Syriac translations read "they mock at us".

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃

records.literal_gloss: God of hosts, restore us, and make shine your face, and we will be saved.

en.L: God of hosts, restore us, \q and make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face shine, that we may be saved.
en.B: God of Armies, bring us back! \q Turn the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face on us, and we will be saved.
en.R: God of Armies, make us what we were before. \q Look on us with kindness, and we will be saved.

fr.L: Dieu des armées, ramène-nous, \q et fais briller {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et nous serons sauvés.
fr.B: Dieu des armées, fais-nous revenir ! \q Tourne vers nous la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et nous serons sauvés.
fr.R: Dieu des armées, rends-nous ce que nous étions avant. \q Regarde-nous avec bonté, et nous serons sauvés.

sw.L: Ee Mungu wa majeshi, uturudishe, \q na uangaze uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili tupate kuokolewa.
sw.B: Ee Mungu wa majeshi, uturudishe! \q Utuangazie nuru ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nasi tutaokolewa.
sw.R: Mungu wa majeshi, utufanye tuwe kama tulivyokuwa zamani. \q Utuangalie kwa wema, nasi tutaokolewa.

es.L: Dios de los ejércitos, haznos volver, \q y haz brillar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, para que seamos salvados.
es.B: Dios de los Ejércitos, ¡tráenos de vuelta! \q Haz que la luz de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro nos alumbre, y seremos salvados.
es.R: Dios de los Ejércitos, haz que volvamos a ser lo que éramos. \q Míranos con bondad, y seremos salvados.

decisions.choice: restore us: bring us back
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv, causative) means to bring back or restore. It may ask God to bring the people back to their former state, to return them from exile, or to turn them back to himself. The prayer is for a full return.

decisions.choice: make your face shine: show us favor
decisions.reason: The words echo the priests' blessing, "the LORD make his face shine on you" (Numbers 6:25; compare 4:7; 31:17; 67:2). A shining face is a look of kindness.

decisions.choice: the refrain again
decisions.reason: Verse 4 returns, now with "God of hosts".

decisions.choice: God of Armies
decisions.reason: As with "the LORD of hosts", the title names God as commander of the armies of heaven and of his people. Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies".

decisions.choice: look on us with kindness; make us what we were before
alternatives: make your face shine; restore us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the shining face and the restoring mean (m1, m2).

source.text: גֶּ֭פֶן מִמִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: A vine from Egypt you pulled up; you drove out nations and planted it.

en.L: A vine from Egypt {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pulled up; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} drove out nations and planted it.
en.B: You lifted a vine out of Egypt; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} expelled nations to plant it.
en.R: Your people were like a vine that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} dug up in Egypt. \q You forced other nations out of the land and planted {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} vine there.

fr.L: Une vigne d’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as arrachée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as chassé des nations et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as plantée.
fr.B: Tu as tiré une vigne d’Égypte ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as chassé des nations pour la planter.
fr.R: Ton peuple était comme une vigne que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as arrachée en Égypte. \q Tu as chassé d’autres nations du pays et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} y as planté {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vigne.

sw.L: Mzabibu kutoka Misri {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliung'oa; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyafukuza mataifa ukaupanda.
sw.B: Uliutoa mzabibu katika Misri; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyafukuza mataifa ili uupande.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walikuwa kama mzabibu ulioung'oa katika Misri. \q Uliyafukuza mataifa mengine katika nchi na kuupanda mzabibu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} huko.

es.L: Una vid de Egipto {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} arrancaste; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} expulsaste naciones y la plantaste.
es.B: Tú sacaste una vid de Egipto; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} echaste a las naciones para plantarla.
es.R: Tu pueblo era como una vid que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} arrancaste en Egipto. \q Tú echaste a otras naciones de la tierra y plantaste allí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vid.

decisions.choice: a vine: Israel
decisions.reason: Israel is pictured as God's vine or vineyard in Isaiah 5:1-7, Jeremiah 2:21 and Ezekiel 15; 17. Jesus takes up the picture in John 15:1-8.

decisions.choice: pulled up: uprooted, set out on a journey
decisions.reason: The verb (nasa', causative) means to pull up tent pegs and set out. It is the word for Israel's journeys in the wilderness, so the vine's uprooting is the exodus.

decisions.choice: drove out nations and planted it
decisions.reason: The conquest of Canaan (44:3; Exodus 15:17).

decisions.choice: your people were like a vine
decisions.reason: Readable says that the vine stands for Israel (m1).

source.text: פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שָׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: You cleared before it, and it rooted its roots and filled [the] land.

en.L: You cleared [the ground] before it, \q and it took root [with] its roots and filled the land.
en.B: You prepared the soil to receive it; \q it put down its roots and covered the land.
en.R: You made a place for it. \q It grew deep roots and spread over the whole land.

fr.L: Tu as déblayé [le sol] devant elle, \q et elle a enfoncé ses racines et rempli le pays.
fr.B: Tu as préparé la terre pour la recevoir ; \q elle a poussé ses racines et couvert le pays.
fr.R: Tu lui as fait de la place. \q Elle a poussé des racines profondes et s’est étendue sur tout le pays.

sw.L: Uliusafishia [ardhi] mbele yake, \q nao ukatia mizizi [kwa] mizizi yake na kuijaza nchi.
sw.B: Uliitayarisha ardhi kuupokea; \q uliotesha mizizi yake na kuifunika nchi.
sw.R: Uliutengenezea mahali. \q Ulitoa mizizi mirefu na kuenea katika nchi yote.

es.L: Tú despejaste [el terreno] delante de ella, \q y echó raíces y llenó la tierra.
es.B: Preparaste la tierra para recibirla; \q echó sus raíces y cubrió el país.
es.R: Le hiciste un lugar. \q Echó raíces profundas y se extendió por toda la tierra.

decisions.choice: cleared: made room, cleared away
decisions.reason: The verb (panah, intensive) means to clear something out of the way, as a house is cleared for a guest (Genesis 24:31). God cleared the land of its nations (verse 9).

decisions.choice: rooted its roots: took firm root
decisions.reason: The verb and noun from the same root stress how deeply the vine was planted.

source.text: כָּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑הּ וַ֝עֲנָפֶ֗יהָ אַֽרְזֵי־אֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Mountains were covered [with] its shade, and [with] its branches [the] cedars of God.

en.L: [The] mountains were covered [with] its shade, \q and the cedars of God [with] its branches.
en.B: Its shadow spread over the mountains, \q and its branches over the giant cedars.
en.R: Its shade covered the hills. \q Its branches spread over even the biggest cedar trees.

fr.L: [Les] montagnes ont été couvertes [de] son ombre, \q et les cèdres de Dieu [de] ses branches.
fr.B: Son ombre s’est étendue sur les montagnes, \q et ses branches sur les cèdres géants.
fr.R: Son ombre a couvert les collines. \q Ses branches se sont étendues même sur les plus grands cèdres.

sw.L: Milima ilifunikwa [kwa] kivuli chake, \q na mierezi ya Mungu [kwa] matawi yake.
sw.B: Kivuli chake kilienea juu ya milima, \q na matawi yake juu ya mierezi mikubwa.
sw.R: Kivuli chake kilifunika vilima. \q Matawi yake yalienea juu hata ya mierezi mikubwa kuliko yote.

es.L: [Los] montes fueron cubiertos [con] su sombra, \q y los cedros de Dios [con] sus ramas.
es.B: Su sombra se extendió sobre los montes, \q y sus ramas sobre los cedros gigantes.
es.R: Su sombra cubrió las colinas. \q Sus ramas se extendieron aun sobre los cedros más grandes.

decisions.choice: cedars of God: the tallest cedars
alternatives: the cedars of God (planted by God)
decisions.reason: Adding "of God" can mark something as the greatest of its kind, as "mountains of God" in 36:7. The cedars of Lebanon were the tallest trees Israel knew (104:16).

decisions.choice: its branches covered the cedars
alternatives: its branches were like mighty cedars
decisions.reason: The verb "were covered" serves both lines: the vine's shade covered the mountains and its branches covered the cedars. The second line can also be read "its branches were cedars of God".

decisions.choice: the mountains and the cedars: the land's limits
decisions.reason: With the sea and the River in verse 12, the hills of the south and the cedars of Lebanon in the north picture the vine filling the whole promised land.

source.text: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣הָ עַד־יָ֑ם וְאֶל־נָ֝הָ֗ר יֽוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: It sent out its branches to [the] sea, and to [the] River its shoots.

en.L: It sent out its branches to [the] sea, \q and to [the] River its shoots.
en.B: It stretched its branches as far as the sea, \q and its shoots to the River.
en.R: Its branches spread all the way to the Mediterranean Sea. \q Its new shoots reached the Euphrates River.

fr.L: Elle a étendu ses branches jusqu’à [la] mer, \q et jusqu’au Fleuve ses rejetons.
fr.B: Elle a allongé ses branches jusqu’à la mer, \q et ses rejetons jusqu’au Fleuve.
fr.R: Ses branches sont allées jusqu’à la mer Méditerranée. \q Ses jeunes pousses ont atteint le fleuve Euphrate.

sw.L: Ulipeleka matawi yake hata bahari, \q na machipukizi yake hata Mto.
sw.B: Ulinyoosha matawi yake mpaka baharini, \q na machipukizi yake mpaka Mto.
sw.R: Matawi yake yalienea mpaka Bahari ya Kati. \q Machipukizi yake mapya yalifika Mto Frati.

es.L: Extendió sus ramas hasta [el] mar, \q y hasta [el] Río sus brotes.
es.B: Alargó sus ramas hasta el mar, \q y sus brotes hasta el Río.
es.R: Sus ramas llegaron hasta el mar Mediterráneo. \q Sus brotes nuevos alcanzaron el río Éufrates.

decisions.choice: the sea and the River: the Mediterranean and the Euphrates
decisions.reason: These were the borders of the land promised to Israel (Exodus 23:31; Deuteronomy 11:24). Under David and Solomon Israel's rule reached them.

decisions.choice: the Mediterranean Sea; the Euphrates River
decisions.reason: Readable names the sea and the river (m1).

source.text: לָ֭מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑יהָ וְ֝אָר֗וּהָ כָּל־עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why have you broken down its walls, and pluck it all [who] pass by [the] road?

en.L: Why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} broken down its walls, \q so that all who pass by [the] road pluck it?
en.B: Why did {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} break down the walls around it? \q Now everyone who walks along the road picks its grapes.
en.R: Why did {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} tear down the wall around {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} vine? \q Now anyone who walks by can pick its grapes.

fr.L: Pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} renversé ses murs, \q si bien que tous ceux qui passent sur [le] chemin la pillent ?
fr.B: Pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} abattu les murs qui l’entouraient ? \q Maintenant tous ceux qui passent sur la route cueillent ses raisins.
fr.R: Pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} démoli le mur autour de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vigne ? \q Maintenant, n’importe quel passant peut cueillir ses raisins.

sw.L: Kwa nini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umezivunja kuta zake, \q hata wote wapitao njiani huuchuma?
sw.B: Kwa nini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulizibomoa kuta zinazouzunguka? \q Sasa kila apitaye njiani huchuma zabibu zake.
sw.R: Kwa nini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulibomoa ukuta unaozunguka mzabibu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? \q Sasa yeyote apitaye anaweza kuchuma zabibu zake.

es.L: ¿Por qué has derribado sus cercas, \q de modo que la saquean todos los que pasan por [el] camino?
es.B: ¿Por qué derribaste los muros que la rodeaban? \q Ahora todos los que pasan por el camino arrancan sus uvas.
es.R: ¿Por qué derribaste el muro que rodeaba {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vid? \q Ahora cualquiera que pasa puede arrancar sus uvas.

decisions.choice: its walls: the vineyard's protecting wall
decisions.reason: Vineyards were enclosed with a wall or hedge against animals and thieves. Breaking it down leaves the vineyard open to ruin (Isaiah 5:5).

decisions.choice: pluck it: pick its fruit
decisions.reason: The verb ('arah) is used of gathering fruit (Song 5:1).

decisions.choice: its grapes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what is plucked from a vine (m2).

source.text: יְכַרְסְמֶ֣נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִיָּ֑עַרוְזִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] boar from [the] forest ravages it, and [the] creatures of [the] field graze on it.

en.L: [The] boar from [the] forest ravages it, \q and [the] creatures of [the] field graze on it.
en.B: Wild boars from the forest tear it up, \q and the creatures of the open country feed on it.
en.R: Wild pigs from the forest rip it apart. \q Wild animals come and eat it.

fr.L: [Le] sanglier de [la] forêt la ravage, \q et les bêtes des champs la broutent.
fr.B: Les sangliers de la forêt la saccagent, \q et les bêtes de la campagne s’en nourrissent.
fr.R: Les sangliers de la forêt la mettent en pièces. \q Les bêtes sauvages viennent la manger.

sw.L: Nguruwe kutoka msituni huuharibu, \q na viumbe wa porini hula humo.
sw.B: Nguruwe mwitu kutoka msituni huung'oa, \q na viumbe wa nyika hujilisha humo.
sw.R: Nguruwe mwitu kutoka msituni wanauraruararua. \q Wanyama wa porini huja na kuula.

es.L: [El] jabalí del bosque la destroza, \q y [las] criaturas del campo pacen en ella.
es.B: Los jabalíes del bosque la destrozan, \q y las criaturas del campo se alimentan de ella.
es.R: Los cerdos salvajes del bosque la despedazan. \q Los animales salvajes vienen y se la comen.

decisions.choice: creatures of the field: whatever moves in the open country
decisions.reason: The word (ziz) is found only here and in 50:11. It seems to mean anything that moves in the field, small or large.

decisions.choice: the boar: a wild pig
decisions.reason: Wild boars lived in the thickets of the Jordan valley and can root up a whole vineyard. The enemies of Israel are pictured as wild animals.

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב־נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וּ֝פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: God of hosts, return, please! Look from heaven and see, and attend to this vine,

en.L: God of hosts, return, please! \q Look from heaven and see, \q and attend to this vine,
en.B: God of Armies, please come back! \q Gaze down from heaven and see; \q care for this vine,
en.R: God of Armies, please come back to us! \q From heaven, look down and see what has happened. \q Take care of this vine.

fr.L: Dieu des armées, reviens, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie ! \q Regarde du ciel et vois, \q et prends soin de cette vigne,
fr.B: Dieu des armées, reviens, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît ! \q Regarde du haut du ciel et vois ; \q prends soin de cette vigne,
fr.R: Dieu des armées, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, reviens vers nous ! \q Du ciel, regarde et vois ce qui est arrivé. \q Prends soin de cette vigne.

sw.L: Ee Mungu wa majeshi, rudi, tafadhali! \q Tazama kutoka mbinguni uone, \q uutunze mzabibu huu,
sw.B: Ee Mungu wa majeshi, tafadhali urudi! \q Utazame chini kutoka mbinguni uone; \q uutunze mzabibu huu,
sw.R: Mungu wa majeshi, tafadhali urudi kwetu! \q Kutoka mbinguni, utazame chini uone yaliyotokea. \q Uutunze mzabibu huu.

es.L: Dios de los ejércitos, ¡vuelve, por favor! \q Mira desde el cielo y ve, \q y cuida de esta vid,
es.B: Dios de los Ejércitos, ¡vuelve, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lo rogamos! \q Mira desde el cielo y ve; \q cuida de esta vid,
es.R: Dios de los Ejércitos, ¡por favor, vuelve a nosotros! \q Desde el cielo, mira y ve lo que ha pasado. \q Cuida de esta vid.

decisions.choice: return: turn back to us
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) is the root of "restore us" in the refrain. The people ask God to come back to them, as they ask him to bring them back.

decisions.choice: attend to: visit with care
decisions.reason: The verb (paqad) means to look into something and act on it; with God as subject it is often his coming to help (8:5; Genesis 21:1).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 16 continues the list of what God is to care for, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: God of Armies
decisions.reason: As with "the LORD of hosts", the title names God as commander of the armies of heaven and of his people. Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies".

source.text: וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל־בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: and [the] stock which planted your right hand, and on [the] son [whom] you made strong for yourself.

en.L: and the stock that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand planted, \q and on the son [whom] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made strong for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}.
en.B: the root {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand planted, \q the son {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} raised to strength for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}.
en.R: You put it in the ground with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hand. \q Care for the son {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made strong to be {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own.

fr.L: et du plant que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite a planté, \q et du fils [que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fortifié pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: de la souche que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite a plantée, \q du fils que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu fort pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Tu l’as mise en terre de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} propre main. \q Prends soin du fils que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu fort pour qu’il soit à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: na shina ambalo mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume ulipanda, \q na juu ya mwana [uliye]mtia nguvu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: shina lililopandwa na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, \q mwana uliyemkuza kwa nguvu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.R: Uliupanda ardhini kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwenyewe. \q Umtunze mwana uliyemtia nguvu awe {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: y de la cepa que plantó {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} diestra, \q y del hijo [que] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste fuerte para {{deity_pronoun:ti mismo|Ti mismo}}.
es.B: la raíz que plantó {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} diestra, \q el hijo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} fortaleciste para {{deity_pronoun:ti mismo|Ti mismo}}.
es.R: Tú la plantaste con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propia mano. \q Cuida del hijo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste fuerte para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}.

decisions.choice: the stock: the root or main stem of the vine
decisions.reason: The word (kannah) is found only here. It probably means the stock from which the vine grows; some read it as a verb, "protect".

decisions.choice: the son: the branch, or Israel as God's son
alternatives: the son of man (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: "Son" can mean a branch of a plant (Genesis 49:22, where Joseph is a fruitful "son", a bough). It also recalls Israel as God's firstborn son (Exodus 4:22). The line is nearly the same as verse 18, and the ancient Greek translation reads "son of man" here as there. An ancient Aramaic paraphrase reads it as the anointed king.

decisions.choice: your right hand: God's own power
decisions.reason: The right hand is the strong hand; God planted the vine himself (44:4).

source.text: שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [It is] burned with fire, cut down; at [the] rebuke of your face they perish.

en.L: [It is] burned with fire, [it is] cut down; \q at the rebuke of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face they perish.
en.B: It has been burned with fire and cut down; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people are dying under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} angry rebuke.
en.R: Your vine has been burned and cut down. \q Your people are dying because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are angry with them.

fr.L: [Elle est] brûlée par le feu, [elle est] coupée ; \q à la menace de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ils périssent.
fr.B: Elle a été brûlée par le feu et coupée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple meurt sous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} regard irrité.
fr.R: Ta vigne a été brûlée et coupée. \q Ton peuple meurt parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es en colère contre lui.

sw.L: [Umechomwa] kwa moto, [umekatwa]; \q kwa kukemea kwa uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanaangamia.
sw.B: Umechomwa kwa moto na kukatwa; \q watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanakufa chini ya kemeo {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} la hasira.
sw.R: Mzabibu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} umechomwa na kukatwa. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanakufa kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umewakasirikia.

es.L: [Está] quemada con fuego, [está] cortada; \q ante la reprensión de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro perecen.
es.B: Ha sido quemada con fuego y cortada; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo muere bajo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprensión airada.
es.R: Tu vid ha sido quemada y cortada. \q Tu pueblo se está muriendo porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás enojado con ellos.

decisions.choice: they perish: the people of the vine
alternatives: may they (the enemies) perish at your rebuke
decisions.reason: "They" most likely means the people the vine stands for, dying under God's anger (verse 5). The verb can also be read as a wish against the enemies who burned the vine.

decisions.choice: the rebuke of your face: God's angry look
decisions.reason: God's face turned in anger is the opposite of the shining face of the refrain.

decisions.choice: your people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "they" are (m1).

source.text: תְּֽהִי־יָ֭דְךָ עַל־אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let your hand be on [the] man of your right hand, on [the] son of man [whom] you made strong for yourself.

en.L: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand be on the man of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand, \q on [the] son of man [whom] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made strong for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}.
en.B: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand protect the man at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand, \q the son of man {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} raised to strength for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}}.
en.R: Put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand on the man {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have placed at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right side to protect him. \q He is the one {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made strong to be {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main soit sur l’homme de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite, \q sur [le] fils d’homme [que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fortifié pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main protège l’homme qui est à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite, \q le fils d’homme que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu fort pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Pose {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main sur l’homme que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as placé à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite, pour le protéger. \q C’est lui que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu fort pour qu’il soit à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na uwe juu ya mtu wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, \q juu ya mwanadamu [uliye]mtia nguvu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na umlinde mtu aliye mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, \q mwanadamu uliyemkuza kwa nguvu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.R: Uweke mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} juu ya mtu uliyemweka upande {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume ili umlinde. \q Yeye ndiye uliyemtia nguvu awe {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano esté sobre el hombre de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} diestra, \q sobre [el] hijo de hombre [que] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste fuerte para {{deity_pronoun:ti mismo|Ti mismo}}.
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano proteja al hombre que está a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} derecha, \q al hijo de hombre que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} fortaleciste para {{deity_pronoun:ti mismo|Ti mismo}}.
es.R: Pon {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano sobre el hombre que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has puesto a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} derecha, para protegerlo. \q Él es el que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste fuerte para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}.

decisions.choice: the man of your right hand: the one God has chosen and upholds
decisions.reason: The man at God's right hand is the one he favors and makes strong: the king (110:1) or Israel itself. The words may also play on the name Benjamin, which means "son of the right hand" (verse 3).

decisions.choice: let your hand be on: protect and strengthen
decisions.reason: God's hand on someone is his power at work for them (Ezra 7:6; 89:22).

decisions.choice: son of man: a human being
decisions.reason: The phrase means simply a human being (8:5), here the one God has made strong. Later readers heard in it the hope of a coming king, the son of man of Daniel 7:13, but the New Testament does not quote this verse.

decisions.choice: to protect him
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's hand on him means (m2).

decisions.choice: "mwanadamu" (a human being) for ben-adam, not "Mwana wa Adamu"
decisions.reason: Here the phrase means simply a human being, as the meaning decision says. The style guide keeps "Mwana wa Adamu" for the title in the Gospels; using it here would read the later title into the psalm.

source.text: וְלֹא־נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And not we will turn back from you; give us life, and on your name we will call.

en.L: And we will not turn back from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q give us life, and we will call on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.B: Then we will not drift away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Bring us back to life, and we will call on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} by name.
en.R: Then we will never leave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} again. \q Give us new life, and we will worship {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Et nous ne nous détournerons pas de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q fais-nous vivre, et nous invoquerons {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.B: Alors nous ne nous éloignerons plus de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Rends-nous la vie, et nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}invoquerons par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.R: Alors nous ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} quitterons plus jamais. \q Donne-nous une vie nouvelle, et nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adorerons.

sw.L: Nasi hatutarudi nyuma kukuacha {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q utuhuishe, nasi tutaliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Ndipo hatutakuacha {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Uturudishie uhai, nasi tutakuita kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Ndipo hatutakuacha {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} tena kamwe. \q Utupe uhai mpya, nasi tutakuabudu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Y no nos apartaremos de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q danos vida, e invocaremos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.B: Entonces no nos alejaremos de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Devuélvenos la vida, e invocaremos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.R: Entonces nunca más {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dejaremos. \q Danos vida nueva, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} adoraremos.

decisions.choice: we will not turn back: a promise
decisions.reason: The people promise faithfulness in return for God's help; the verb (sug) means to move back or desert (44:19).

decisions.choice: give us life: revive us
decisions.reason: The verb (chayah, intensive) means to keep alive or bring back to life (71:20; 85:7).

decisions.choice: call on your name: worship and pray
decisions.reason: As in 79:6, to call on God's name is to pray to him and worship him.

decisions.choice: worship you
decisions.reason: Readable says what calling on God's name means (m3).

source.text: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH God hosts, restore us; make shine your face, and we will be saved.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God of hosts, restore us; \q make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face shine, that we may be saved.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God of Armies, bring us back! \q Turn the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face on us, and we will be saved.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God of Armies, make us what we were before. \q Look on us with kindness, and we will be saved.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu des armées, ramène-nous ; \q fais briller {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et nous serons sauvés.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu des armées, fais-nous revenir ! \q Tourne vers nous la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et nous serons sauvés.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu des armées, rends-nous ce que nous étions avant. \q Regarde-nous avec bonté, et nous serons sauvés.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa majeshi, uturudishe; \q uangaze uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili tupate kuokolewa.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa majeshi, uturudishe! \q Utuangazie nuru ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nasi tutaokolewa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa majeshi, utufanye tuwe kama tulivyokuwa zamani. \q Utuangalie kwa wema, nasi tutaokolewa.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de los ejércitos, haznos volver, \q y haz brillar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, para que seamos salvados.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de los Ejércitos, ¡tráenos de vuelta! \q Haz que la luz de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro nos alumbre, y seremos salvados.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de los Ejércitos, haz que volvamos a ser lo que éramos. \q Míranos con bondad, y seremos salvados.

decisions.choice: restore us: bring us back
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv, causative) means to bring back or restore. It may ask God to bring the people back to their former state, to return them from exile, or to turn them back to himself. The prayer is for a full return.

decisions.choice: make your face shine: show us favor
decisions.reason: The words echo the priests' blessing, "the LORD make his face shine on you" (Numbers 6:25; compare 4:7; 31:17; 67:2). A shining face is a look of kindness.

decisions.choice: the refrain at its fullest
decisions.reason: The psalm ends with the refrain of verses 4 and 8, now with the fullest name, the LORD God of hosts.

decisions.choice: LORD God of Armies
decisions.reason: As with "the LORD of hosts", the title names God as commander of the armies of heaven and of his people. Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies".

decisions.choice: look on us with kindness; make us what we were before
alternatives: make your face shine; restore us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the shining face and the restoring mean (m1, m2).
